scope: Lorekeepers Codex German localization only. All 438 authored German page bodies and titles read, all 206 interface strings and 45 chapter summaries read, all 29 supplement entries read. All 447 readable source records structurally audited. The 1215 shipped game-transcript pages were screened as a corpus, not individually certified word for word.
verdict: Complete authored coverage and usable German, but needs targeted meaning, grammar and runtime fixes. Keep the first-translation flag.

findings.suggested: Use a stable readable identity or map every known source-language title to it.
findings.note: A saved French Lettre simple remains French after switching to German. Current code documents English-only conversion. Extend the contract explicitly if all prior library copies should follow the new client language.

findings.suggested: Match personalized first pages with placeholder-aware patterns, or keep a safe discriminating prefix before the token.
findings.note: Sealed Research Report fails to localize when Hello, $N is expanded to Hello, Thorin. Even an unexpanded literal $N fails because generator removes N but runtime retains it. The title still appears German.

findings.suggested: Add a durable classic-by-hand.json override mapping Zirkel des Cenarius to itself and regenerate classic.json, or suppress article-only differences in the glossary generator. Do not only hand-edit this generated file.
findings.note: Loading the actual German file through Locale.lua on Classic creates double articles in eight paragraphs (druids, tauren, moonglade, cenarion-circle, silithid, abyssal-council, ruins-of-ahnqiraj, silithus) and the Cenarion Circle title. Forever has zero. The TBC TOC loads the same Classic content. Static checks pass.

findings.current: The books you keep in the Library read in the game's own French or German too.
findings.suggested: Books in the Library can also be read in French or German. Existing game translations are supplemented with our own translations where needed.
findings.note: The German supplement records 25 addon-authored translations. This should not be described as uniformly the game's own wording. Existing saved French copies and some personalized English reports also remain untranslated after a language change.

findings.suggested: von den Nerubern
findings.note: Dative plural after von requires -n.

findings.suggested: Diese Furbolgs gehören nicht zur Holzschlundfeste, die die Tunnel im Teufelswald bewacht.
findings.note: Use the official faction label Holzschlundfeste, but correct the plural/singular construction and distinguish the furbolgs from the fortress.

findings.current: über Kalimdor, einem See aus reiner Magie
findings.suggested: Vor zehntausend Jahren herrschten die Nachtelfen vom Ufer des Brunnens der Ewigkeit aus über Kalimdor. Der Brunnen war ein See aus reiner Magie im Herzen der Welt.
findings.note: The lake apposition is misplaced and its case does not agree with the intended noun. Next to Kalimdor it suggests the continent is a lake. Make the Well the explicit subject of a second sentence.

findings.suggested: überrannten die Ausgräber
findings.note: Gräber normally means graves, not excavation workers. Recurs elsewhere.

findings.suggested: den Ausgräbern der Liga
findings.note: Same diggers/graves ambiguity.

findings.suggested: unter den Stachelebern
findings.note: Dative plural, also sweep similar race nouns.

findings.suggested: zuerst die Ausgräber findet
findings.note: Same diggers/graves ambiguity reverses the punchline.

findings.suggested: wo die Ausgräber graben sollten
findings.note: Diggers translated as graves.

findings.suggested: Historiker, Archäologen und Ausgräber
findings.note: League described as consisting of graves.

findings.suggested: Eine Stelle als Lehrer
findings.note: Teaching post became an apprenticeship vacancy.

findings.current: um sie noch einmal zu schlagen
findings.suggested: um die Schlacht noch einmal zu schlagen
findings.note: English fight it again points explicitly to the battle. German sie can refer to the battle, but the nearest antecedent is the spirits, producing the distracting reading defeat the spirits. Name the battle to remove that ambiguity.

findings.current: mit den Hochelfen von Quel'Thalas ausbilden durfte
findings.suggested: mit den Hochelfen von Quel'Thalas trainieren durfte
findings.note: Ausbilden is transitive educating others, not training alongside them.

findings.suggested: ihre Ausgräber der Schattenschmiede
findings.note: Diggers translated as graves.

findings.current: Ihre Absichten hat man rein genannt, selbst wer
findings.suggested: Ihre Absichten wurden selbst von denen als rein bezeichnet, die ihren Umgang für fragwürdig halten.
findings.note: Even by those became even whoever, lacking link to predicate.

findings.current: und seither brennen sie: die Toten
findings.suggested: und seither verbrennen sie die Toten
findings.note: Burn enemies became intransitive burn. Keep the cutting tone but correct verb.

findings.current: indem er hilft, was darin falsch gelaufen ist
findings.suggested: indem er hilft, die Probleme im Wald zu lösen
findings.note: English helping with becomes German helfen with a direct-object was clause. Use helfen bei or helfen plus infinitive.

findings.current: durch sehr viel schlechte Geschichte führt
findings.suggested: durch eine düstere Vergangenheit führt
findings.note: Bad history means dark past, not low-quality historiography.

findings.suggested: betrachteten die Ausgräber als Freiwild
findings.note: Diggers translated as graves.

findings.current: blickt auf die Kirin Tor von Dalaran, um ihnen zu zeigen, wie
findings.suggested: hofft, von den Kirin Tor in Dalaran zu lernen, wie das gelingt
findings.note: The English looks to the Kirin Tor to show them how makes the Kirin Tor the source of guidance. German um ihnen zu zeigen normally carries Elaadrin as the subject and can read as him instructing them. State that he seeks to learn from them.

findings.current: die Ebene der Elemente zu wagen
findings.suggested: sich in die Ebene der Elemente zu wagen
findings.note: Venture into requires sich in ... wagen.

findings.current: und von Spielern, deren Volk oder Berufung noch eine Seite zu finden hat.
findings.suggested: und von Spielern, für deren Volk oder Berufung dir noch die Seite fehlt.
findings.note: The race/class is made the subject that must find a page. The player is the one who lacks it.
findings.english_key: A line on the tooltip of creatures that unlock a page (a page to find, or its title once found), and of players whose people's or calling's page is still to find.

findings.suggested: Wowhead provides no German body for these pages.
findings.note: A missing localized body in Wowhead does not establish what the real game client contains. Correct the stronger claim.

findings.suggested: endlich die nötige Fähigkeit beweisen
findings.note: Muster the competence is clumsily literal. Better preserve the speaker's contempt with endlich fähig genug sein.

findings.current: Wir packten unsere Sachen und kehrten gut gelaunt ins Lager zurück.
findings.suggested: Wir packten unsere Sachen und kehrten bedrückt ins Lager zurück.
findings.note: English says solemnly after the terrifying tiger appearance. The German client-cache wording says cheerfully. This is inherited upstream, not an authored supplement mistake. Preserve verbatim only by conscious choice.

findings.suggested: Er brach die Gefängnisse auf
findings.note: The literal prison-breaking is awkward German. Both destroying the prisons and breaking them open fit the English. This is idiomatic polish, not a lore correction.

findings.current: Es schlug auf den Gletscher von Eiskrone in Nordend
findings.suggested: Es schlug auf dem Eiskronengletscher in Nordend ein
findings.note: For an impact, einschlagen or aufschlagen is more idiomatic than the bare schlagen construction. This is a wording correction, not a changed event.

findings.suggested: einen dauerhaften Befehl
findings.note: Stehender Befehl can occur in military usage, so this is not a confirmed mistranslation. Dauerhafter or allgemeiner Befehl is clearer for ordinary readers.

findings.suggested: der Draenei Kum'isha
findings.note: Kum'isha is explicitly named Kum'isha der Sammler in both pinned games. Der Draenei is consistent with this masculine client label. Generic English draenei did not specify gender.

findings.current: brach die Horde in der folgenden Flucht
findings.suggested: schlug die Horde in die Flucht
findings.note: Rout rendered as flight, with unclear side retreating. Verify English.

findings.suggested: um die Höhlen zu säubern
findings.note: Masculine pronoun has only Taragaman nearby, not the plural caves. Check English.

findings.suggested: endete mit dem Tod beider Männer
findings.note: English absolute construction copied into German.

findings.current: mit dem hirschgleichen Unterleib seines Vaters
findings.suggested: mit einem hirschgleichen Unterleib wie dem seines Vaters
findings.note: Can imply possessing father's literal body. English also compressed, classify optional clarification.

findings.current: dass sie bis vor wenigen Jahren alle Zeit der Welt hatten
findings.suggested: dass sie bis vor wenigen Jahren alle Zeit der Welt hatte
findings.note: The English uses singular they. German switches from eine Nachtelfe to plural hatten without making the collective reference explicit. Either retain singular hatte or deliberately name the whole people.

findings.suggested: vollständig niedergebrannt
findings.note: Burned to the ground calque applied to an entire forested valley.

findings.suggested: Verify the inscription and use a glacier-specific expression, such as an der Gletscherzunge, if that is what it describes.
findings.note: Mouth was carried into German as the river term Mündung. Gletscherzunge or an approach/entrance may be intended, but the exact landmark is not pinned by the source. Clarify only after checking the inscription. This is a wording/source question, not a proven changed location.

findings.suggested: Es ist schlicht befriedigend, wenn eine Entdeckung zuerst die Werkbank und erst später die Geschichtsbücher erreicht.
findings.note: Ehrliche Befriedigung is understandable, so this is optional polishing. A simpler formulation makes Archesonus's pleasure in a useful discovery more immediate and less abstract.

findings.suggested: Helft dem Captain
findings.note: English Attend to him is also compressed. Clarify help for Stoutfist rather than accidentally referring back to defeating Nek'rosh. This is ambiguity, not a proved reversal.

findings.current: Eine Geschichte, die es wert ist
findings.suggested: Eine erzählenswerte Geschichte
findings.note: Achievement title drops telling and leaves worth it without its complement.

findings.suggested: Alle Lebenswege
findings.note: Walks of life means kinds of people/backgrounds, not changing circumstances.

findings.current: Ein Klick darauf liest die Seite.
findings.suggested: Ein Klick darauf öffnet die Seite.
findings.note: A click opens a page, it does not read it. Appears in two alert descriptions.
findings.english_key: Show each new page in the game's own alert. A click on it reads the page.

findings.current: das vergisst jede Seite und jeden Erfolg, die dieser Charakter gefunden hat.
findings.suggested: das löscht alle gefundenen Seiten und erhaltenen Erfolge dieses Charakters.
findings.note: Warning uses forget as a literal action and achievements are earned rather than found.
findings.english_key: this forgets every page and achievement this character has found. Type /codex reset yes to do it.
